results.headline: Assay Results confirm High-Grade Copper-Silve...
results.key_quote: This is an excellent set of results from our first systematic sampling campaign, whereby surface grab samples were collected quickly and cost-effectively during routine geological mapping. It is encouraging that the samples have returned grades of this quality across multiple prospects and over a significant strike length, showing us signs of a large fertile mineralised system, rather than an isolated occurrence.
results.summary: Serval Resources announced assay results from surface grab samples at its Kaoko Basin project in Namibia. The company reported high-grade copper-silver mineralisation with best individual results of 37.8% copper and 573 g/t silver (45.49% copper equivalent), multiple samples exceeding 10% Cu-Eq across six prospects, and mineralization over approximately 5 km strike length. A new copper prospect (Okamborombonga) was identified, bringing total confirmed copper prospects to 13. Results will inform the company's planned maiden diamond drilling programme in Q4 2026.
